title: Orders per Visit, Open Bookings per Order and Specimen Drop-Off — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
Training sheet, Patient Services: the per-visit order limit, the open-booking settings per order and the drop-off setting of each **Specimen Collection Appointments** visit type, with the questions these settings answer.

| Visit type | Most orders collected in one visit | Booked visits allowed at one time for the same order | Future draws of one standing order bookable at the same time | Self-collected urine specimen may be dropped off without a draw |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | 6 | 1 | 0 (one at a time) | Yes |
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | 6 | 1 | 4 | Yes |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | 6 | 1 | 4 | Yes |
| Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection | 2 | 1 | 0 (one at a time) | No |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | 4 | 1 | 2 | Yes |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | 6 | 1 | 2 | No |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | 6 | 1 | 12 | No |

**What is the most orders one visit can collect?** It is the figure in the second column: 6 for most visit types, 4 for the Pediatric Collection Appointment and 2 for the Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection.

**How many booked visits may exist at one time for one order?** One, for every visit type; the "booked" count covers visits not yet checked in.

**How many future draws of a standing order may be booked at once?** The fourth column gives it: 12 at a Facility Bedside Collection Visit, 4 at a Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment or Fasting Priority Appointment, 2 at a Pediatric Collection Appointment or Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, and 0 — one at a time — at the walk-in visit and the Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection.

**Where can a patient drop off a self-collected urine specimen without a draw?** Only at visit types whose last column reads "Yes": the Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit, the Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment, the Fasting Priority Appointment and the Pediatric Collection Appointment.
